usage: Common noun for a ring worn on the finger; very natural in everyday Cantonese.
Often used with possessive words like '隻' or numbers when counting rings, e.g. one ring, two rings.
Can refer to any kind of ring, including wedding rings, fashion rings, and gemstone rings.
Very common in shopping, jewellery, and relationship contexts; neutral and standard spoken usage.
